_comment: Editable copy for the home page. Rendered with data-copy attributes so it can be edited in the browser under `npm run dev` — see tools/copy-editor.mjs. The exceptions are heroTitle and heroStandfirst, which render with their tokens substituted and so are deliberately NOT browser-editable: see _count and _systems below, and edit them through `npm run copy:export` instead. Case study titles and summaries are not here: they live in src/data/studies.ts, which is already one readable file and is shared with the next-study rotation.
heroStandfirst: {systems} on the design system, the other on product design.
_brands: Per-brand overrides. Rendered alongside the default and chosen at runtime by [data-brand]; see base.css. Only strings that name a company belong here, which since 2026-08-26 means ALL of them: the default brand deliberately names none. Its line has to work for a stranger who reached the apex with no covering message, so it says what the site is rather than who it is for. "In full" is the argument the whole project rests on, that a study which skips the explorations, the testing and the numbers is a gallery entry rather than a case study.
_count: The {count} token is how many tiles THIS brand sees, spelled as a word and substituted in index.astro. Keep the braces and never type a number: each brand is offered a different number of studies, so a typed count is right for one hostname and wrong for the rest. Not hypothetical — the Wise hero read "Two case studies" above a three-tile grid until 2026-08-17.
_systems: The {systems} token is how many of THIS brand's studies argue design systems, spelled as a word and substituted in index.astro. Keep the braces and never type a number. "the other" asserts exactly one product-design study and the build refuses any other shape. Not hypothetical: this read "One on the design system" on Wise and Healf, which are both offered two of them, until 2026-08-19 — the same bug as _count one discipline across.
